dict.string: Orion listens only while you hold the Right Option key. Your voice is transcribed on this Mac and is never recorded to disk.
Orion controls Apple Music only when you choose it for a focus session, so the session player can play, pause, skip, seek, and show your current track.
Orion reads your calendar so it knows what is actually in your day before it tells you how much of it is left. It only reads; it never creates or changes events.

Orion keeps your task list in a Reminders list called Orion, so the tasks you add here show up on your iPhone and remind you there. It only reads and writes that one list.

Orion reads your contacts so a phone number in a message can be shown as the person's name. It only reads; it never adds, edits or sends anything to your contacts.
Orion turns what you say into text so it can answer you. Transcription runs on this Mac whenever your language supports it, so your speech stays local.

Orion can check whether you are at your desk during a focus session. It takes one frame every 90 seconds, turns it into a single number, and discards it — nothing is saved or sent. The green camera light will be on whenever it looks. This is off unless you turn it on.
